NFI.gap: All buckling requirements use kd = 0.2 and scale as 1/kd. MAINLINE-004's named knockdown curve is still running.
NFI.direction: Multiply each E requirement by 0.2/kd when 004 lands; no other number changes.
NFI.effect: A larger knockdown factor lowers every required E in this card.

NFI.gap: 276 MPa is a QUESTIONABLE typical tensile yield transferred to compression (inherited NFI-AL-YIELD-CARRY). Required strengths here are membrane stresses and do not depend on it; only the x276 MPa multiples and SF labels do.
NFI.direction: Obtain a compressive design allowable and rescale the multiples only.
NFI.effect: No required Pa value in this card moves.

NFI.gap: P2 equal-mass figure holds face separation at the row value while face thickness follows 1/rho. A changed face density moves tf and so moves separation by the same amount, a second-order change against 0.1-0.16 m cores.
NFI.direction: Recompute E/rho with separation following tf if a candidate face material is far from 2700 kg/m3.
NFI.effect: Small optimistic or pessimistic shift in the P2 buckling figure for extreme densities.

NFI.gap: P3 figures use thin-wall A and I at fixed outer radius. P3-A has tw/ro = 0.175, where thin-wall understates I for a given mass.
NFI.direction: Use exact annulus A and I for a named candidate section.
NFI.effect: P3-A's E/rho requirement is mildly pessimistic; exact section helps it.

NFI.gap: Film allowable 1.5 GPa is inherited from MAINLINE-001 with no pinned datasheet (inherited NFI-FILM). The film passes at SF 2.51 on that value.
NFI.direction: Pin one film datasheet; required allowable 5.966e8 Pa is the bar it must clear.
NFI.effect: A real film below 5.966e8 Pa allowable would govern P3 and P3-A.

NFI.gap: Core shear, face wrinkling, core crush, local crippling and end fixity remain outside these two limits, as in 002/003. Core crush is worked next as MAINLINE-005b.
NFI.direction: 005b for crush; later cards for shear, wrinkling and crippling.
NFI.effect: Any omitted mode can only lower a row's true SF below the figures here.
